staking.heroDesc: Lock SYNTH on X Layer to build your multiplier over time. Requesting an unstake freezes your multiplier and starts a 7 day cooldown before withdrawal.

staking.resetTimerNote: Adding more stake resets your timer and multiplier back to 1x.
staking.insufficientBalance: Insufficient SYNTH balance for this amount.
staking.cooldownNote: Request Unstake removes your position from active staking immediately. Funds stay locked for 7 days before you can finalize.
staking.rewardNote: Phase 1 does not distribute reward tokens yet. The reward token constructor slot remains reserved for future activation.
staking.aliceIntroDesc: Alice is a decentralized AI training network. Anyone can contribute compute power to train Alice AI and earn ALICE token rewards. No pre-mine, no team allocation — 100% mined. SynthLaunch channels token tax revenue into continuous compute support for the network.
staking.flowStep1Desc: Tokens launched on SynthLaunch generate trading tax
staking.flowStep2Desc: Tax revenue is converted into GPU compute driving AI training nodes
staking.flowStep3Desc: Decentralized training — model weights maintained by the whole network
staking.flowStep4Desc: Stake SYNTH longer to boost your multiplier and earn a larger ALICE allocation
staking.aliceFlowNote: The longer you stake SYNTH, the higher your multiplier — and the larger your future ALICE reward share. Phase 1 records positions and multipliers; reward distribution will be enabled in a future version.
